Smoke test: load baml and parse a simple snippet

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"class Person {
  name string
  age int
}

enum Level {
  Junior
  Senior
}

function Greet(p: Person) -> string {
  p.name
}
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"language":"baml"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config);
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
